x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf's Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing is expected as early as next week.

NJ federal court. PIF loan: less than $100M.

Players with multi-year guarantees could be left with pennies on the dollar. #LIVGolf

LIV launched in 2022. Guaranteed contracts. Saudi backing. 48 players. 12 teams.

Four years later: bankruptcy court.

The most disruptive force professional golf had ever seen is about to file Chapter 11. #LIVGolf
